title: Smol Serafimz Official Wiki
intro:
Welcome to the official Smol Serafimz Wiki. 

Smol Serafimz is a hobby project made by LordFluffs depicting cute and mischievous slice-of-life moments of the titular characters in a carefree world. It's presented in various mediums, though most commonly as a comic. 

This wiki serves as a database that logs all notable lore and data from the franchise as it grows over time.

cast.title: Meet the Cast
cast.intro: Cozy Realm is a home to all sorts of being and creatures. Comic introduces many new characters over time. Here you can learn more about them.

episodes.title: Episodes
episodes.intro: Episodes are weekly published and are together forming seasons. Each season tends to have its own theme and changes, always improving upon the previous.

world.title: Explore the World
world.intro: Cozy Realm may be a cute paradise realm but it's bigger than it seems. Here you can read about each notable location.

objects.title: Objects
objects.intro: Objects that appear more commonly or are of higher importance are listed here.
